text: Reinstalled after about 12 months away. Still far too many in game pop up's trying to get you to spend. Open the app, 6 pop up's every time. Run out of spins, 5 pop up's every time. Complete a village 3 pop up's every time. It's ridiculous. Stop trying to force people to purchase. I've uninstalled again due to the disgusting amount of almost begging for our money pop up's.

You have to pay to get anywhere. There is over 200 levels. The algorithm is set for you to pay for extras inorder to get to other levels. You fall short of 'spins' to complete tasks. Those who buy extras seem to have a one up on you all the time. Somehow, one person was attacking my profile every 10 seconds. Another tournament, I had it autospin but never could win. I never purchased anything and only got just to level 50. To finish the game will cost you about £185, for the big package.

This game.. I've been addicted to for the past 2 years. however just recently since the change to week long events I no longer find the game fun and I am quickly losing interest and playing less and less. it isn't just me either most of my players on my team feel the same way. They all hate it. Having to spread the main event across 2 team events just isn't working the only way it works is to sacrifice a team event for better rewards on the next one. which is boring!

started off great. Ended up with you cant even go an hour without being totally wiped out. You spend a fortune buying the items and within an hour you have been attacked so many times you are back to square one. You only get 5 spins an hour, and yet you can be attacked 10 times!!!!! The higher the level the more it costs to build your village. Started off as an enjoyable game but turned out to be very disappointing. I have spent a fortune on this game but have now deleted it. Very disappointed :

It's a typical addictive game that's designed to absolutely rinse you of cash and make you pay for in app purchases as much as possible. If you don't make any purchases, your progress is slow and painful. The prizes in the tournaments are too small to make any decent progress from winning, even if you come in the top 3 or even 1st. Some cards you'll never ever get, some are so ridiculously rare. It's become predictable and am getting bored with it...I'm going to stop playing it I think!

Less of a game, more of a time waster. The start-up time is also a little slow even on a high end device. You have to exit out of at least 5 pop-ups and sometimes more if there's an event on just to get to the actual game. Which, isn't much of a game, it's a slot-machine which sometimes gives you money and allows you to pillage other villages. The main goal is to upgrade your village property fully then leave, players can steal from you but I still have no idea how the loot is ordered.

The only point of this game is pay to win. Its just a slot machine with a "village building" mechanic over the top. You spin you get gold. You upgrade pointless buildings, until you complete then onto the next. The game constantly spams you to add or invite friends, to give your email, your fb account. It bombards you with adverts to spend money. There is no point to this game. If I had kids I would be worried, as this is the sort of game they would run up hundreds of pounds in.

Brilliant game, badly, in fact, terribly let down by its implementation. Really enjoyed it at the beginning, being able to attack friends villages is a Brilliant idea and a good wind up when we meet up. HOWEVER.... its badly let down by the number of "pop ups" highlighting/advertising power ups etc for the game. The last straw was when I opened the game, I had to click through 20 odd (not kidding) pop ups before I could play. Just deleted the game at that point. Really disappointed :-(

Great game to start with, if you don't spend real money after a while, the game starts taking things from you like spins, rewards and events. Complaints get you nowhere but generic info. Shame, could be a brilliant game. Even after numerous failed attempts of contacting customer support, to recieve the same generic email, and then to be ignored.

I've had so many issues with this game. some times when you finish an event it doesn't give you your rewards or it freezes and I've been cheated out of spins and coins so many times. when you email support you don't even get a reply so whats the point in having it on there when they clearly couldn't careless if you have issues ,their just after your money . I was cheated out of 2000 spins in set blast a while ago and still nothing from them.

Addictive game at first, but the constant pop ups are so off putting. When you get higher up the village chain it costs more than 50 spins worth of prizes to even build part of one village... the constant events are great, WHEN you can get the attacks or raids. Another annoying thing with this game, is that someone on your fb friends list can easily attack you over and over, as I have found out. Being attacked 10 times in an hour! Completely destroyed level 52 village that was almost complete!!

I really got into the game and even made some in game purchases. however I now have a glitch where the coin master is stuck on one person, and I get an error message whenever I 'raid' them. it means I can't take part in events and it has yet to be fixed even though I sent a support message a week ago. it's kinda ruined my enjoyment of the game, which is unfortunate

Very poor. I have been playing this game for a long time, level 145. However now it messes up all the time with my coin and spin rewards and I don't receive them and now it constantly says lost connection constantly so can no longer access the game, I have tried all the solutions but still nothing **reply** I can't contact through support in the game as it will no longer load, I have unistalled it, removed all history, shut my phone down and restarted it, still will not load, I can't even access

Like many games of this type, the developers hugely overcharge for additional resources (including the "sales", which are available every day). There is also little to no decision making, do you attack the person who just attacked you or do you attack someone at random? As you are likely to get raided and attacked within an hour of logging out, whichever option you pick, this decision is largely pointless. Needs more actual gameplay.

Really addictive good game, I'd like to give it 5 stars.... The only issue with it is every time you log on or run out of spins it gives you 5.6million pop ups asking if you want to buy more spins etc. If I want to buy them I will click on your links at the side of the game which I've done in the past. I don't need you forcing it down my throat. If you have really good patience then I'd recommend this game. If not stay waaaay clear.

This game used to be so good!! Now they have increased the price of everything, use bots to destroy your villages and raid your savings! Constantly trying to get you to make a purchase and making the game almost impossible to play. Trying to get cards from chests to complete sets is almost impossible! When u contact support they dont even reply!! Giys you have made a great game into a nightmare!! No wonder the ratings have dropped.

I used to love this game, simple but fun. However, lately it's been incredibly glitchy. Takes rewards away from me, fails to recognise me spinning 3 symbols and moves onto the next spin etc. When you send in reports, nothing ever gets done to fix it and now they've taken away the daily rewards from emails and Facebook, everything is just a link to their game now. It's no fun when you get things taken from you and are just expecting to not progress further. Sad sad.

Despite how the ads make it seem, it's just not a very interesting game. Admitedly, I played it only for about five minutes (just long enough to use my spins and poke about the menus), but as far as I can tell, it's a slot machine with a "village building" thing tacked on the side. You do your spins, get money, build village. The village doesn't *do* anything, its not animated or provides income. The "raids" that are it's big feature are just "look at base, tap something". 'least it looks okay.

I FEEL CHEATED!!! The amount of money I've spent and ppl I've brought to the game it's amazing how I get the short end of the stick. I get raided constantly whenever I have tons of coins (let's say 15 mill) and when the stupid game gives me the opportunity to raid other ppl the most they have is less than 1 mill. on top of that you lot stop giving me spins whenever I get more ppl to join. It's really unfair. I think this the very first app I've ever reviewed in all these years but, i had to

I've uninstalled the game now, with regards to a review. I don't understand what the game is for?.. Or the point! The graphics aren't great let's face it! How its top grossing game...I don't know. Is the game for money or fun? Or both? I can't understand what's going on apart from someone attacks your village( if you can call it that) you attack theirs by digging in certain places then you get gold coins! Please tell me the point of it all...I might give it another try then!?

Game is fun however very annoying and not balanced. You get attacked over night and get your city destroyed , very enough then you have to rebuild HOWEVER If you chose not to build anything, then you get your money stolen from you!! Really !! I spent £1.79 to get some extra free spins and build the cash ( around 5 Mil ), only to log in after couple of hours to find my money stolen!!! Is this for real ? A game is meant to be fun ... Where is the fun here , I'm actually pretty annoyed.

This game is, well, okay... The third village definitely feels the least progressive as I was there for around 3 days. But this game works on a 'luck' sort of mechanic, which is definitely fixed to give you a certain number of coins every time. For example no matter how well my prizes are everyday, I always have just under a million coins before I can progress onto the next village, so it's not really luck at all but a gaming mechanic to make you play longer and await more coins the next day.

This has to be the most frustrating game, taking all the fun out of it. While I understand part of the game is to find new cards. Cards are now constantly being duplicated and very rare I get new cards. I have quite a few sets to complete and its impossible, one of the sets isn't even a gold card. I don't spend money on it I just play for what's available. I finished a village after winning 1.5b coins so I spent the rest magic chests to only get one card out of approximately 56 cards RUBBISH!!!

The aim of the game is to build villages, which costs 'coins'. In the game, 550 coins costs £94.99. To build ONE item in my latest village I need 2.3 BILLION coins, meaning it would cost £417 (this is just to build ONE of 25 total items in this village). As you can see, it's impossible to progress past later levels without spending a lot of money. I hope legislators crack down on this kind of game, the creators should be ashamed.

Overall, it's an "okay" game, well, that's if you can really call it a game, because all it is in reality is an app that is legally trying to get you to spend money at EVERY opportunity it can and more lol, i certainly don't mind the odd situation where it may be beneficial to say buy something, but if I'm going to spend I want something for my money, not something that simply runs out and your money is gone in most cases with no benefit at all. It's a bit of a timewaster, that's all really.

I can't stop playing this game! It's frustrating tho that you have to wait for spins & only get 5 an hour & the spins are full at 50. it should be 10 every 30 minutes (minimum) & full spins at 200 (minimum) the villages are so expensive that you don't stand a chance of buying anything (unless you get a lucky raid) I would play much more if I didn't have to wait for my spins to mount up. But I still love this game!

Updated: I purchased one of the rewards in the game, the app froze and I didn't receive the rewards. This happened twice. I explained the situation to customer services - they were unhelpful and suggested I had allowed unauthorised access to my game account (with no proof or further explanation). After being emailed by three or four different people, I received a refund from Google Play instead. Game also lags a lot and is slow. Very poor customer service.

PLAYER BEWARE! THIS GAME IS A SCAM!!the game is set up to pull you in and then demand huge amounts of cash to get anywhere once you reach higher levels! At first you get lots of winning spins but as you get higher they get less and less, cards become VERY difficult to obtain and require huge amounts of coin! Worst part is the game is actually fun and could be amazing but the developers have made it far too money hungry! Shame really! Standard reply! How about making the game fair! And less greed

It is a good game, but you have to wait an hour for 5 SPINS and then so on. Plus you have to keep crossing off loads of stuff before you can actually play, I notice that I got loads of money but can't hardly spend it because it takes ages to get the money up as you gotta wait for spins. Also I notice it take a lot of time just to complete a village because you have to wait loads of hours for your spins to get full. Really need to fix this or I won't be playing anymore it is such a poor game.!!

I would have rated this more before all the changes that have happened with friends.many of my friends have issues connecting their other friends to the game,it doesn't seem to be working properly,they have reduced some set rewards (pet food),for example the ocean and mythical set. On a positive note,you do not have to spend to progress far in this game like everybody seems to think.You just have to find your game strategy. CM are continuously trying to make the game more difficult for players.

With a 5 card send limit, how do you guys expect us to help, trade and for us Admins of groups to provide fun in the way of games, events for our members as well as to help other players to complete sets? You're also not the best of help with certain situations, for example I have a player on my game that isn't a friend on FB or in the game itself but yet she's managing to attack and raid me... If these issues get resolved, I will edit my review but until then this is final.

As everyone has said....Good to start off with and addictive fun then you have to keep buying expensive packs if you want to proceed. Lots of pop up ads to entice you to buy and during that time your village has been damaged. I did pay for a few packs and I noticed as soon as I had my village was damaged and would cost more to fix. I have deleted the app and feel less stressed as no notifications that my village has been damaged....yet again! Shame as was fun without all the additional costs.

Used to love this game however the bugs and errors are so bad it's got to the point it's stopping me from playing. Coin master support team do NOT reply and are of NO help! Around a month ago I stopped playing due to being unable to take part in the raid master event as I was unable to collect any rewards. Now I finally decide to start playing again yesterday, I've been playing the event with no problems, now today I am again unable to collect my rewards again. I find this very convenient and a lot of other players are having the same problems with no help from moon active. Last time coin master team just sent me the reward amount of 4m coins and I was unable to take part for the rest of the event time, losing out on millions of coins. I find this unacceptable as it means I lost out on so much more due to being unable to play again, and I've spent real money on this game. Due reporting this game as they cannot keep taking hard earned money from people and conning them ensuring they cannot gain!

Although I really like the game,I am really annoyed by the fact that I never get the rewards after I followed all the steps...liked, shared,completed the survey,installed an app game and played 100 levels(lost island) and NOTHING!!! NOT FAIR.I will change my rating if I will receive something. P.S. By the way, yesterday I wasn't able to get my reward for the Attack event as there was a technical error and took ages to be sorted out. I've seen tens of posts where people were rewarded,but me.

The game is a con. I spent over 100 billion trying to complete the most recent viking trail. It just wasnt possible, I emailed support to share my concerns only to be fobbed off with we are very busy and will get back to you. I do occasionally spend money on the game. The odds of completing the trail were very unfair. Id urge people not to spend money on the game. I had to give 1 star otherwise id of given 0. Thanks

As like others on here... I've been unable to play for the last few days. Game as become stuck during Attack Master Challenge. Won 9m and never gave coins and unable to click onto anything. I have followed your troubleshoot guide and I've messaged your "support" team twice and each time you email me with a generic reply asking me to contact support! I've done everything that you have asked... Sort it out please.

Picked it up as a time waster, but do NOT try to play seriously! I spent 8 months collecting a specific currency (thor tokens) in prep for Black Friday events, only for a bug of sorts to set my rewards to the first tier rather than the last. After contacting support, it was clear they didn't want to bother working on it, so they said it was intentional, in essence telling me they screwed me out of 8 months token collecting. So I'm done, as they have no support process for issues.

Frustrating!! I am fed up of being attacked 3 or more times in a row by the same people, there's far too many pop ups of the different promotions or telling me I'm out if spins! I'm on the game, I can see what I have and haven't got!! Today because of this my money was stolen 1 second before I was able to spend it!! Last week I spent the entire week stuck in the same place, because I couldn't get enough money together to build the village, now I've deleted the game!! Because I'm fed up of it!!!

SCAM DO NOT DOWNLOAD!! all this company is interested in is how much money they can get out of each player. The do not credit rewards. Card collection is impossible to complete unless you spend your own hard earned cash and the just randomly double the price of items (in game currency) for no reason. The make the game so so so difficult to get through just so you buy in game things with your own cash to help along the way. It's not fun it's just expensive.

I don't see the actual point in this game. People keep saying how it is fun, and addictive. I don't actually see any "game" element in this, you just click a few buttons to collect gold coins to buy buildings in a village where the prices just go up and up, therefore needing more coins. I think you need your head examining if you spend money on it.

Great game apart from a few issues. Can be very frustrating waiting for spins, you never seem to have enough spins in time to win the prizes. Maybe you should get spins in with the chests you can purchase with the coins?? The chests! Great that you can purchase cards but the chances of getting new cards in the chests are slim to none! Ive spent over 1 5 billion coins and didnt get a single new card. Maybe make the chances of getting new cards higher...

Events don't always last long enough, everytime you load the game and everytime you run out of spins you get Lord knows how many messages pop up on screen trying to get you to invite friends and buy spins and coins. Very annoying! Pet isn't useful most of the time unless your willing to spend real money on pretend food. Only playing this at the moment because my friends playing it! What could win me over is having more to do in the game. A little too simple.

This might actually be an alright game if not for all the annoying popups... I clearly know when I'm out of spins yet it always prompts me, and with 2 or 3 popups each time! Plus you log on and it tells you about every event, regardless of whether or not you already saw them! tl;dr If you want to spend more time clicking on the x button than playing the game, then this is the game for you!

was good to start off with but as you progress this game is impossible. from waking up each day to a wrecked village often down to 6 or 7 attacks from strangers to the price of the items as you progress. it isn't doable. I was on the last level for 3 weeks and cant even afford one item on new level with a measly 50 spins. 5 spins an hour is not enough. I have also been blocked from getting spins for inviting people, yet I have only maybe invited 50 people 🤔🤔🤔. I'm about done with this game

Loved this game until recently. Constant annoying pop-ups. In addition, I'm stuck on a level, whereby within maybe 20 minutes, all my shields are gone. They used to be enough for a number of hours. Not anymore. I will NOT be making any more purchases. Absolute rip off. Pure greed has ruined a really good game. You should be ashamed of yourselves.

Don't review the game so early. I'm at the stage where it impossible to reach next stage without spending money. I can't save coins as with in 1-2 hours I lose 90% of my coins, than you have to repair the objects that's have been destroyed by other players. The higher you climb the more dependent you'll be on buying spins as free 50 spins which you get 5 per or 10 per hour if the event on just won't cut it. My friends have quit playing as they just can't get enough coins to reach next level.

This has to be one of the worst games I've played that just bombards you with micro transaction purchases. Everytime you load the game up there's anything from 4 to 12 pop ups wanting you to pay £2.99 here, £94.99 there! Currently I have 8 of these with an accumulated total of £233.92, yip you read that correctly, £233.92 which doesn'tactually get you much. Games like this is what's wrong with mobile gaming and it's only getting worse. The game gets boring quickly, especially after level 100.

I find the game really good and addictive but it takes an hour for your spins to regenerate would like to see this dropped down to less time and the higher the levels you go the more coins it costs for you to upgrade your village. By this time either you've been raided or your village completely attacked. I also find that when the tasks are available the required ie. raids attacks etc become less frequent please can you sort this out.

I am becoming very disappointed with the game. CM are making it more difficult to get rewards. I have spent real money playing the game but it hasn't made it any easier. It is almost impossible to complete Viking Quests now, even if I start with 100B coins. I have also won the first gold card a number of times and received one that I already have - even though I had several unlocked that I needed. The game is becoming more difficult and less fun to play.

In order to complete a level ( village ) you have to buy items for gold coins which are won from spins, rewards or bought for real money. Same item in the same village costs almost double on my phone than on another one which is not fair. That means that if two players buy extra lets say 500 milions of coins, one player will end up not having enough for same items that second player bought. Game removed ! Not stealing my money any more 😃

Loved the game at lower stages but come on...50 spins for completing villages that cost 3T+ coins? You get that for completing the first villages....plus having to close all the purchases EVERY time you open the game is a bit much when you have multiple purchases on offer. We know they are there to open if we want them. Once a day closing them is enough surely? Apart from those things i really enjoy playing and recommend the game to others.

The game is great. But once you use your spins it is pointless so can only really play for 5 minutes a day. And as you get onto higher levels, 5 spins is totally useless. You should get more spins per hour with a bigger pot for maximum spins as you go up the levels as you can't get enough to make it worthwhile playing. 5 spins does not make enough coins to fix your village, let alone build it and buy chests to complete sets.

I think the game could be a little more giving at certain times. Seems like every time I get close to completing a task it always cuts me just short of my task at hand, no matter how big or small the task. Seems to happen 9 outta 10 times. And it gets very very frustrating. Other than that I absolutely enjoy this game. I'm even giving 5 Stars⭐ with that one acception. It's a BIG set back. It's like the game has a hold on you, and you can't go any further, but you try day after day just hoping...

A very addictive game. It's fun, colourful and gripping. The only slight issues is that you have to pay for some things and it strongly bribes you to play on Facebook, and it is strictly stopping you from some activity in the game until you log in to Facebook! I don't have Facebook and I'm happy enough to keep playing without having to use social media!! Also, the motion within the villages as you move up the ranks deteriorates, making it seem the creators are a little lazy. A great game though!

You have to wait an hour for 12 spins which is really nothing in this game. After you wait for hours it stops giving spins at 130. I feel like if you wait overnight it should give some for each hour. They should give more and maybe by the half hour instead of the hour. When you get chest to open 98% of the time you get duplicate cards that you need to complete set for more spins. It's all a setup for you to spend money!

I just completed a village and the game has a special that gives 50 extra spins and other items for completing a new village. It refused to give to me and stated I had already gotten. This is just a part of the problem but being cheated makes me mad. Also I have had 9 new people join from my friends requests and I have not been given a single spin as promised by the game.

So I love this game, its a great time waster. But there are some massive gripes with the game 1. Using your Spins but getting it all stolen whilst you're still spinning (other games don't let this happen whilst active) 2. 50 Spins takes for ever, especially when you are high level and high stars 3. prices etc are understandable for buildings but give them more Spins per level or something? 4. The pets don't seem to change the outcome, I seem to do better without. Same with the bigger x bonus

Space eater. It starts off small but quickly fills up your storage. And is not worth it. Mostly likely some form of phishing app to collect your data. Especially from your Facebook. I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS GAME. Automated reply system to reviews. Not a good thing especially when people have actual grievances with your game. I understand not being able to review every single one. But really?

The game ia fun, and very addicting but frustrating at the same time. Most of the gold cards you need to collect hardly ever show. Even when you buy a ton of chests, which is a waist of coins if thats the case. The tournaments are not divided into people's levels so if your low level you stand no chance against someone with 60k spins. When attacking none of the names on the revenge list have a team name on them so your teammates attack you without even knowing.

Edit: Appears not to be working at all today, I keep getting a error message saying connection lost please check your internet connection. This is happening on wifi and mobile data. I've been playing for over a year now, really enjoy it. There appears to be a slight gliche with it at the moment though. When 'buying' or winning a magical chest all the cards are coming out with NEW on them even thought they aren't

Love the game and had a 5 star for me bit recently the glitches have been kicking me out of the game so I don't get the prizes or gifts! I've missed out on 2 pink tokens and spins because when I go back in I don't relieve them. The other thing is buying chests for cards. I spent over 100 billion on the purple chest and not even 1 new card. That was super disappointing, I could have used that to build my village if I had know I would get absolutely nothing new!.

Horrible and gruesome pay to play tactics. Just down right sad. 5 spins per hour, $5 dollars USA for 60 spins flashes in your face every time ur out of spins. I gathered 45 spins overnight woke up and played those spins in 6 mins. In the 45 spins I got 600,000 points. I needed 888,880 to buy the last item to go to lvl 3. In the first lvl I got like 4million out of 50 spins and got to lvl2 in 15mins. Barely got lvl 3 took 4 days. The closer I got to lvl 3 the less points I started to receive and the flashing out purchasing spins or points were always there telling me to to buy buy buy. These tactics are awful... But it's free and easily u deleted from my phone.

Simple concept and the game IS addictive. Mainly because your notified every 10 minutes that someone is attacking you... Make sure you never run out of spins!! You get ambushed by so many pop ups asking you to buy spins or invite your mom's nans dog to join the game. This is EVERYTIME as well. You have a multiplier for spins to gain more rewards and if you have X15 on and then have only 10 spins left, it pesters you, then when you change your multiplier and run out again, it does it again!!

This has gone from the best game to worse game! For some reason the creators are targeting some players and make it impossible to for them to move on with game. Rewards are so low to get compared to what you need to complete them. So I am always at loss. Friends of mine who are at similar point as me woke up to great rewards but not more. If you complain they never get back to you. Seems like they are only interested in players who can afford to pay for extras. Once I run out of spins thats it!

It's a fun game to play with/against friends. I feel like as you level up your spin allowance or rewards should go up to as many people reach a higher level then give up as its just too hard to advance in the game. Hence my lower score. Spins also aren't really given frequently enough but I guess that's how they monetize it, frustrated people who don't wanna wait for more spins!

This is my second review. After the last round of play, I made over 2,000 roses in the rose tournament and didn't get one single gift!!! Also, the amount of baseball's that I received when I got three hammers in a row would go from 10-15, also, it would go from 20-25 for three pigs in a row. The village I'm currently starting, I bought the first item, a table and the second item, and when I went back to purchase more my table was gone! NOT HAPPY!!!!! Please address these issues!!!!

Good app for developers. Not TOO shabby for everyone else either. Just wish they would allow trading of lower level Gold cards instead of all the ones I've never even heard off at like level 300 or something. I want my Firebird card!! Lol. Only time I ever even seen it up for grabs, it was a tournament prize with all the top players in it.( Peepl that been playing for years.)what chance do we mere mortals have? Not much. Unless your loaded and have money to spend on silly games.

Disgusting amount of pop ups for pay to play, have to click through 4/5 advertisements daily just to be able to actually play the damn game, game is lacking and is only any good for killing time, doesnt go anywhere and doesnt really have a point/objective to the game other than to get enough coins to move to the next level where you have to repeat the same tasks again and again, pointless game filled with nothing but advertisements.

The game is good, but lately, when you attempt to attack a person's village, it gives an error message about the connection. This means you lose your spins and the coins you would've won after the attack because it won't allow you to attack, so you must restart. I've contacted customer service and their answer was restart and make sure I have the latest version, which I already knew and I have. They don't really help.Also, there's tons of pop-ups every time you play which can get very annoying.

Game is good, although at higher levels you should be able to get more spins, for example, there is a possibility to double up coins, we could have something similar. Prizes at higher levels should be higher. Coin craze ( doubling up coins) should not start the clock until all pop ups have gone,this is unfair as you can't start playing until all pop ups have been clicked away, so wasting time. 3 spin symbols barely ever come. If prices were lower more people woukd buy your packages.

Download crazy fox instead. Been playing this game for four years and it's getting worse than I ever recall. If the developers want you to play why do I lose between 5 and 10k spins each event . It's all pre determined so that when your close to being out of spins they hope you will pay for more spins to continue playing. Nah ... I'm pretty much done. Crazy fox is enjoyable and is less about trying to make you part with your hard earned cash. Download that instead . You'll have more fun.

Absolutely loved this game until I almost got to 1000spins on the attack madness feature and then it reset to the beginning. Emailed support but received no reply. Also, the majority of the card sets are impossible to complete. I have bought over 1000 chests and have no received any gols cards that completed my sets. I don't often pay for games but I have for this as some of the deals were reasonable but seems they just want your money & don't care about user experience. I feel cheated.

Pop ups are very annoying.
